label: MN1::CXXC5

sections.text: MN1 encodes a transcriptional regulator involved in developmental and hematopoietic programs.
CXXC5 encodes a CXXC-domain transcriptional regulator involved in developmental signaling.
The fusion creates an abnormal MN1-containing transcriptional regulator. Experimental tumor models show oncogenic activity and convergence with MN1::BEND2-driven astroblastoma programs.
